references.body: This isn't quite right. It really isn't meaningful to perform control flow analysis on an expression that wasn't assigned a flow node in the binder because without it you have no antecedent chain. The one notable exception may be the expression of an arrow function where you know there's no preceding code. I think the best approach here is to have the binder always initialize the `flowNode` property of `return` statements and then use that as the antecedent when analyzing expressions of (single) return statements. That would allow you to get rid of the single return statement exclusion logic you have below.

references.body: If we trust proxy `40.40.40.40`, but not trust `30.30.30.30` (proxy it is or not), then ClientIP should be `30.30.30.30` as `20.20.20.20` was set by somebody untrusted. Please do not forget that `X-Forwarded-For` is appended, so it should be processed right-to-left: right-most IP address is the IP address of the most recent proxy and the left-most IP address is the IP address of the originating client.

findings.body: RemoteIP 在请求处理路径中把 prepareTrustedCIDRs() 的结果写回共享的 Engine 字段 c.engine.trustedCIDRs。Engine 被所有并发请求 goroutine 共享，写入的 slice header 指针/长度可能撕裂，并由其他 goroutine 同时读取（第 772-773 行）。这是典型的数据竞争，go test -race 并发调用 ClientIP 会报 DATA RACE。
findings.trigger: 两个及以上并发请求同时进入 ClientIP/RemoteIP（任何多并发 HTTP 服务都会触发）；或一次请求写、另一次请求在 772-773 行读该字段。
findings.impact: 数据竞争；理论上可读到指针与长度不匹配的 slice header，导致遍历 trustCIDRs 时越界 panic 或读到错误信任列表，使 ClientIP 判定异常。
findings.suggestion: 不要在请求路径写 Engine 字段：trustedCIDRs 应在启动阶段（Run/New 或 sync.Once）一次性计算并缓存，RemoteIP 只读；若必须按需计算，改为调用局部变量或加 sync.Once/atomic。用 go test -race 并发调用 ClientIP 验证。
findings.verification_reason: RemoteIP() 在请求处理路径（每个 HTTP 请求 goroutine）中无条件执行 c.engine.trustedCIDRs = trustedCIDRs，写入共享 Engine 的字段，随后又在同一函数第 772-773 行从该字段读取。Engine 由 http.Server 在多个 goroutine 中并发处理请求，因此存在对同一内存位置的无同步并发写-写及读-写访问，按 Go 内存模型构成数据竞争，go test -race 并发调用 ClientIP/RemoteIP 会报告 DATA RACE。字段为 slice header（指针+长度+容量），并发写读可能读到撕裂值，导致遍历时越界 panic 或读到不一致的信任列表。启动路径 Run() 虽也在 gin.go:333 写入该字段，但无法消除请求路径每次写入所造成的竞争。

findings.body: 新增默认值 TrustedProxies: []string{"0.0.0.0/0"} 只覆盖 IPv4 全网段。经 net.ParseCIDR 得到 4 字节掩码网络，RemoteIP 中用 net.IPNet.Contains 判断 IPv6 远端地址时因长度(16)与网段长度(4)不符返回 false，trusted=false，ClientIP 会直接返回远端 IPv6 地址并完全跳过 X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP。
findings.trigger: 使用默认配置，服务位于 IPv6 监听/代理之后，Request.RemoteAddr 为真实 IPv6 地址时调用 ClientIP()。
findings.impact: ClientIP 退化为代理的 IPv6 地址，基于 ClientIP 的限流、审计日志、ACL 会失效或误判。
findings.suggestion: 默认值补充 IPv6 网段（如 ::/0），或明确文档要求 IPv6 场景显式配置；补充 RemoteAddr 为 IPv6 且断言采用转发头的测试用例。
findings.verification_reason: 默认配置 TrustedProxies=["0.0.0.0/0"] 经 prepareTrustedCIDRs→net.ParseCIDR 得到 IPv4 4 字节掩码网络；Context.RemoteIP 用 cidr.Contains(remoteIP) 判断，Go 的 IPNet.Contains 对 16 字节纯 IPv6 地址因长度与 4 字节网段不符返回 false，从而 trusted=false；ClientIP 中 `if trusted && ...` 短路，直接返回 remoteIP.String()，完全跳过 RemoteIPHeaders（X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP）。机制与触发路径在固定提交源码中全部可见且可推导，无待核实前提。

reference_verdicts.reason: The reference flags the ClientIP X-Forwarded-For algorithm/test at context_test.go:1433: XFF must be scanned right-to-left and the result should be the first untrusted hop (30.30.30.30), not 20.20.20.20. No system finding touches the right-to-left parsing logic or the test expectation; finding 0 is about a data race and finding 1 is about IPv6 CIDR matching, so the core issue is unaddressed.

The reference is a design question about whether a trusted RemoteIP's trust can be inherited by all XFF entries (proxies may append rather than reset XFF). Neither finding discusses the trust-inheritance semantics of RemoteIP; finding 0 merely notes a concurrency problem in the same function, which is a different root cause.

finding_verdicts.reason: RemoteIP/ClientIP writes prepareTrustedCIDRs() back into the shared Engine field c.engine.trustedCIDRs on the request path while other goroutines read it at lines 772-773. Since Engine is shared across all requests, this is a genuine data race that -race would flag; a real, actionable concurrency defect the human reviewers did not mention.

net.ParseCIDR("0.0.0.0/0") yields a 4-byte network, and IPNet.Contains returns false for a 16-byte IPv6 address, so the default TrustedProxies never trusts IPv6 remotes and XFF headers are silently ignored for them. This is a correct, non-obvious functional gap in the new default configuration and worth raising.

results.title: fix to_json for numbers larger than sys.maxsize

references.body: This goes back to L1636. CPython manages a global error and we never explicitly clear it on that line. You could call `PyErr_Clear()` but it actually would be better if you used `PyLong_AsLongLongAndOverflow` and checked for a non-zero overflow.
references.author: WillAyd
references.audit_note: objToJSON.c:1632-1640 已改用 PyLong_AsLongLongAndOverflow + overflow 检查，全局错误状态依赖移除

references.body: Make sure you Py_DECREF these objects when they are no longer needed or else this will leak memory.
references.author: WillAyd
references.audit_note: objToJSON.c:2141 已加 Py_DECREF(repr)

references.body: If this object gets released would also free bytes, so need to memcpy first. Also just use Py_DECREF for these as simple enough to see lifecycle.
references.author: WillAyd
references.audit_note: objToJSON.c:2137-2138 先 PyObject_Malloc + memcpy，再于 2141 行 Py_DECREF(repr)

references.body: You will want PyUnicode_AsUTF8AndSize here. You can pass outLen as the second argument.
references.author: WillAyd
references.audit_note: objToJSON.c:2136 已用 PyUnicode_AsUTF8AndSize(repr, (Py_ssize_t *)_outLen)

references.body: Bytes is assigned to cStr but you won't free it in this branch. We need an extra branch that checks for the JT_BIGNUM type and frees cStr in that case.
references.author: WillAyd
references.audit_note: 未新增 JT_BIGNUM 分支而改设计：bytes 走 GET_TC(tc)->cStr（2139 行），由 endTypeContext 通用 PyObject_Free 释放（与 PyObject_Malloc 配对），泄漏已消除

references.body: No need to prepend an underscore here; may be confusing to authors who expect that to mean something. (`int overflow = 0;`)
references.author: WillAyd
references.audit_note: objToJSON.c:1632 已去下划线：int overflow = 0

findings.body: 新增的 Object_getBigNumStringValue 未检查 PyObject_Str 与 PyUnicode_AsUTF8AndSize 的返回值。若 repr 为 NULL（对象字符串化失败，例如 MemoryError，或 CPython 3.11+ int_max_str_digits 限制触发的 ValueError），PyUnicode_AsUTF8AndSize 会以 NULL 参数被调用，随后 memcpy(bytes, str, ...) 直接解引用空指针，导致解释器崩溃而非抛出可捕获异常；同时 PyObject_Malloc 返回值也未校验，且 *_outLen 可能未被写入。
findings.trigger: 对超过 sys.maxsize 的 Python 整数编码（走 JT_BIGNUM 路径）时，PyObject_Str 或 PyUnicode_AsUTF8AndSize 失败返回 NULL。待核实前提：该环境下整数的 str 转换确实可能失败（如极大位数受 int_max_str_digits 限制或内存不足）。
findings.impact: C 层空指针解引用造成进程崩溃（段错误），无法通过 Python 层异常捕获，属于进程级 DoS 风险。
findings.suggestion: 在取出 repr 后先判断 repr == NULL，失败则直接返回 NULL 交由上层报错；再判断 str == NULL，失败时 Py_DECREF(repr) 后返回 NULL；同时对 PyObject_Malloc 返回 NULL 做处理。可写一个把 str 转换强制失败的用例（或构造超长整数）验证不再崩溃。
findings.verification_reason: 新增函数 Object_getBigNumStringValue（objToJSON.c:2133-2144）对 PyObject_Str(obj) 与 PyUnicode_AsUTF8AndSize 的返回值均未做 NULL 检查，随后直接用 memcpy 解引用。触发路径可查证：Object_beginTypeContext 在 PyLong_Check 且 PyLong_AsLongLongAndOverflow 溢出时设置 tc->type = JT_BIGNUM（objToJSON.c:1637-1639），而 ultrajsonenc.c:1111-1112 的 JT_BIGNUM 分支调用 enc->getBigNumStringValue(obj,&tc,&szlen)，即该函数。按 CPython API 契约，PyObject_Str 在转换失败时返回 NULL 并置异常；对超过 sys.set_int_max_str_digits（3.11+ 默认 4300 位）限制的整数做 int→str 转换会抛 ValueError，故对一个溢出 long long 且位数超限的大整数（如 10**5000）编码 JSON 时 repr==NULL。此时 PyUnicode_AsUTF8AndSize(NULL, ...) 内部先执行 PyUnicode_Check(NULL)→Py_TYPE(NULL)，解引用空指针直接崩溃；即使不崩，memcpy(bytes, NULL, ...) 也会解引用空指针。崩溃发生在函数返回前，ultrajsonenc.c:1115 的 enc->errorMsg 检查无法到达，异常也无法被 Python 层捕获，构成进程级崩溃。PyObject_Malloc 返回值同样未校验，属同一缺陷的次要分支。

findings.body: 参数化提供了 sys.maxsize + 1 与 -(sys.maxsize + 2) 两个大整数，但函数体第一行 bigNum = sys.maxsize + 1 覆盖了入参，负值用例永远不会执行，参数化只是重复跑同一正值用例。
findings.trigger: 运行 test_dumps_ints_larger_than_maxsize 时固定使用正值，负值参数被丢弃。
findings.impact: 负的大整数编码路径（PyLong_AsLongLongAndOverflow 返回负溢出值、输出含负号）无测试覆盖，后续回归可能漏检。
findings.suggestion: 删除该赋值行，直接使用参数 bigNum；并确认两种参数下 ujson.encode(bigNum) 的输出与 str(bigNum) 一致。
findings.verification_reason: 新增的参数化用例在函数体第一行以 `bigNum = sys.maxsize + 1` 无条件覆盖入参，导致双向参数化（正、负）中的负值 `-(sys.maxsize + 2)` 分支永远不会被使用，两次执行等价于同一正值用例。该覆盖在 diff 新增行中直接可见，无需外部定义即可推导，属实。

findings.body: 新增条目中 :issue: 与反引号之间存在多余空格，Sphinx 不会把它解析为 issue 引用角色，会按普通文本渲染而丢失链接；同时这里写的 34395 与测试注释中的 GH34473/GH34395 不一致，issue 编号存在笔误可能。
findings.evidence: - Bug in :meth:`ujson.encode` was raising an `OverflowError` with numbers larger than sys.maxsize (:issue: `34395`)
findings.trigger: 构建文档渲染 whatsnew 页面时。待核实前提：该 issue 编号应为与测试一致的编号。
findings.impact: 发布说明中的 issue 链接失效或指向错误 issue，影响用户溯源。
findings.suggestion: 去掉 :issue: 后的空格写成 (:issue:`NNNNN`)，并核对与测试中引用的 GH 编号一致。
findings.verification_reason: 新增的 whatsnew 条目写成 (:issue: `34395`)，内联角色标记 :issue: 与反引号之间存在空格。reStructuredText/docutils 的内联角色语法要求 :role:`text` 中角色名后紧跟反引号，不允许空白；因此该模式不会被识别为 :issue: 角色，而会被渲染为字面文本 :issue: 加一个默认角色文本，pandas 通过 extlinks 定义的 GitHub issue 链接不会生成，链接丢失。同一行前面的 :meth:`ujson.encode` 写法正确、无空格，说明这里确实是格式错误而非 diff 呈现造成。触发路径明确（Sphinx 构建该 whatsnew 页面），影响限定为发布说明中的链接失效，属文档缺陷。候选附带提出的 issue 编号笔误（34395 与测试注释 GH34473/GH34395 不一致）在本轮证据中无法核实，但不影响“链接丢失”这一核心结论。

reference_verdicts.reason: The snapshot already uses PyLong_AsLongLongAndOverflow with an overflow flag (line 1633), i.e. the requested change is present. No system finding claims this issue still applies.
The snapshot already contains Py_DECREF(repr) in Object_getBigNumStringValue. No system finding asserts a missing DECREF / memory leak there.

The snapshot already does memcpy before any release and uses Py_DECREF, so the flagged leak-of-bytes issue is fixed. Finding 0 talks about the unrelated NULL-pointer hazard, not about freeing a released object, so it does not re-assert this issue.
PyUnicode_AsUTF8AndSize is already used with _outLen as second argument, i.e. the suggestion is applied. No finding re-raises it as pending.

references.body: Here's a list of scenarios: 1. a replica gets disconnected and gets a full-sync when it reconnects. 2. a replica was connected to one master and got redirected to a new master (of the same replication chain) and got a full sync for some reason. 3. redis was restarted from rdb file (after a graceful shutdown), and has replicaof config, attempted a partial sync with the replid it got from the rdb file, but gets a full sync. 4. the replica was a master till now and got some data from that era, then gets a REPLICAOF command and does a full-sync. 5. the replica started empty and is attempting its first sync ever. 6. the replica was replicating from a certain master, and is now full-syncing from another master that's completely unrelated to the previous one. i think the first 3 scenarios want to allow clients to read the data, but on the last 3 we don't! i think the rule here is that if the current dataset in the db represents a valid point in time of the master we're full-syncing from, then we wanna allow reads, but if it doesn't represent a certain point in time of that master, then we don't want to serve reads.

findings.body: isRestoreContext() 宏体没有外层括号，调用处 `isRestoreContext()? LL_VERBOSE: LL_WARNING` 会被解析为 `cond ? 0 : (1 ? LL_VERBOSE : LL_WARNING)`（三目运算符右结合），因此结果只可能是 0 或 LL_VERBOSE，LL_WARNING 分支永远不会命中：cond 为真（即真正在装载 RDB/AOF 时，server.current_client 为 NULL 或 CLIENT_ID_AOF）返回 0，也就是 LL_DEBUG，而不是 LL_WARNING。
findings.trigger: 在 RDB/AOF（含 AOF 的 RDB preamble、以及 swapdb 异步全量同步）装载期间，rdbLoadLzfStringObject / rdbGenericLoadStringObject 中 ztrymalloc/sdstrynewlen 分配失败，执行 serverLog(isRestoreContext()? LL_VERBOSE: LL_WARNING, ...)。此时 current_client 为 NULL 或 AOF 客户端，cond 为真，返回 0。
findings.impact: 装载期的 “failed allocating ...” 消息被以 LL_DEBUG(0) 级别记录，而 Redis 默认 loglevel 为 notice，该消息不会输出，导致装载过程中的分配失败/OOM 告警被静默丢弃（改动前这里是 server.loading ? LL_WARNING : LL_VERBOSE，装载时会以 WARNING 输出），排障信息丢失。
findings.suggestion: 给宏体加上外层括号：`#define isRestoreContext() ((server.current_client == NULL || server.current_client->id == CLIENT_ID_AOF) ? 0 : 1)`，或在调用处不依赖宏返回 0/1 而直接内联条件判断；修复后可验证装载期分配失败时确实以 LL_WARNING 输出。
findings.verification_reason: 宏 isRestoreContext() 的定义体为 `(cond) ? 0 : 1`，没有把整个三目表达式用外层括号包住（src/rdb.c:52-53）。因此调用处 `isRestoreContext()? LL_VERBOSE: LL_WARNING` 文本展开为 `(cond) ? 0 : 1 ? LL_VERBOSE : LL_WARNING`，按 C 三目运算符右结合规则解析为 `(cond) ? 0 : (1 ? LL_VERBOSE : LL_WARNING)`；而 `1 ? LL_VERBOSE : LL_WARNING` 恒为 LL_VERBOSE，所以整体表达式恒等于 `(cond) ? 0 : LL_VERBOSE`，LL_WARNING 分支为死代码。可见调用点（rdb.c:388、399、532、548）都使用了该宏的三目写法，且在 RDB/AOF 装载期 cond 为真（current_client 为 NULL 或 id==CLIENT_ID_AOF），于是 serverLog 的级别取值为 0（LL_DEBUG），而非预期的 LL_WARNING。这是缺陷主张的核心机制，由可见源码与 C 标准运算符优先级/结合性直接推导，触发路径明确。
